source.description:
PROBLEM: The Specialist Fleet UI is a debug projection, not an operational fleet, and violates the agreed hierarchy twice over. At specialists head it paints with ctx.ui.setWidget(FLEET_WIDGET_KEY, content, { placement: 'aboveEditor' }) plus a redundant ctx.ui.setStatus(...) line, rendering raw forensic fields (activation_id, access, bead_id, raw counts) above the editor. The agreed hierarchy puts the fleet immediately BELOW the XTRM statusline, owned as a footer section, with collapsed/expanded operational semantics copied from pi-subagents interaction (not its placement).

SUCCESS: (1) Fleet renders as a composable section of the XTRM footer directly below the statusline; no aboveEditor widget, no setStatus line. (2) Collapsed line shows active/waiting/needs-reply + aggregate context/tokens + inspect hint, with needs-reply outranking idle state. (3) Expanded view shows one row per specialist (model/thinking, bead, meaningful state, elapsed, token/window, current activity when available), bounded with overflow, activation_id kept in the inspector only. (4) Keyboard: editor-empty Down/Left activates, Up/Down or j/k selects, Enter attaches the live Specialist AgentSession, Esc returns to coordinator. (5) Proven in a live TUI, not just unit tests.

SCOPE: Specialists repo fleet surface (config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs fleet widget block, src/tools/specialist/activation.tool.ts projections, src/activation telemetry exposure as needed) plus the footer composition seam in the core repo (core/packages/pi-extensions/extensions/custom-footer/index.ts, sole setFooter owner, currently no section API). Decomposed into child beads; this epic tracks the whole.

NON_GOALS: Claude-side fleet (no Claude TUI surface exists), auto-dispose/TTL policy, changes to pi-subagents itself, docs site updates.

CONSTRAINTS: Footer ownership stays singular -- custom-footer remains the only setFooter caller; the fleet registers a section, never a second footer. Fleet view stays a projection (no cached state between ticks). Operator instruction: every dispatch under this epic passes model_override opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor. Cross-frontend parity rule applies to any wording both frontends share.

VALIDATION: Live TUI demonstration: fleet visible below the statusline with collapsed line; keyboard nav to expanded rows; Enter attach opens the live child session; needs-reply state outranks idle; unit tests cover row formatting, overflow bound, and section registration fallback. Each child states its own evidence.

OUTPUT: Merged implementation across core seam + specialists fleet, live demo evidence recorded on the implementation bead(s), this epic closed when UI-1..UI-7 all hold live.

SCRUTINY: medium

REFERENCES:
- Current fleet: specialists config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs (FLEET_WIDGET_KEY, renderFleetLines, paintFleet).
- Footer owner: core packages/pi-extensions/extensions/custom-footer/index.ts (setFooter, render(width)).
- Interaction model: pi-subagents src/ui/agent-widget.ts (setWidget callback form) and src/ui/session-navigator.ts (ui.custom non-overlay mount, keyboard nav).
- Telemetry: specialists src/activation/forensic-sink.ts (startedAtMs, tokenUsage, elapsed), src/tools/specialist/activation.tool.ts (toActivationView fields).
- pi SDK widget/custom API: ExtensionAPI types in the pi install (dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts).

AGREED HIERARCHY (target):
conversation
────────────────────────────────────────
› coordinator prompt/editor
~/mercury/platform(main)  61%/200k  gpt-5.6-sol high  o:18 p:3
SPECIALISTS · 2 active · 1 waiting · ↓/← inspect

UI-1  Move Fleet into a composable XTRM footer section below statusline. Remove aboveEditor placement.
UI-2  Remove the redundant ctx.ui.setStatus Fleet indicator.
UI-3  Adopt pi-subagents collapsed Fleet semantics: active/waiting/needs-reply + aggregate context/tokens + inspect hint.
UI-4  Adopt its keyboard behavior: Down/Left activate, Up/Down or j/k select, Enter attach, Esc coordinator.
UI-5  Replace debug-oriented rows with: Specialist, model/thinking, Bead, meaningful state, elapsed, token/window usage, current activity when available.
UI-6  Keep activation_id, participant_id, attempt_id, access, full result and forensic details in inspector/status, not permanent UI.
UI-7  Bound the expanded Fleet and use overflow rather than allowing it to consume the terminal.
NOTE: copy pi-subagents presentation and interaction, NOT its belowEditor placement -- XTRM has the custom footer it lacks, hence the footer-section seam.
source.notes:
OPERATOR LIVE OBSERVATION 2026-09-08: Down/Left do nothing; only the collapsed specialist-active line + arrows render. Root-caused: keys handled only inside ui.custom inspector; no global key API for passive extensions in pi 0.85.1; pi-subagents also opens via slash command only. Split to ready bug unitAI-4n9of (fix the hint, not the keys). WORKAROUND for operator: /fleet inspect opens the keyboard navigator.
OPERATOR LIVE OBSERVATION 2026-09-08 (severity: session-killing): /fleet inspect causes heavy TUI flicker; operator killed the window and reopened. Suspect 1s paintFleet poll fighting the ui.custom inspector. Split to P1 ready bug unitAI-z49s2. Inspector unusable until fixed; /fleet, /fleet:reply, /fleet:stop (non-custom surfaces) unaffected.
OPERATOR LIVE OBSERVATION 2026-09-08: collapsed line renders one char per row (~40 rows) above statusline after restart/resume. Both render paths verified type-correct in source; units mock ui so never catch renderer behavior. Hypotheses: resumed-session layout width (H1), stale widget (H2), double-load (H3). Split to P1 ready bug unitAI-dygdq. Awaiting operator discriminating test (fresh session + resize).
OPERATOR DECISION 2026-09-08: /fleet inspect hard-locks the TUI (fresh session, post string[] fix). Interactive inspector (UI-4 keyboard/attach) deliberately DEFERRED -- ui.custom path itself at fault in this pi version. Replacement: expanded rows by default with full one-row details (ready bead unitAI-nmxhg). unitAI-dygdq fix stands as correct but its surface is removed. Live attach deferred with UI-4; /fleet:reply and /fleet:stop remain the action paths.
OPERATOR LIVE OBSERVATION 2026-09-08: elapsed works on rows, tokens never display. Root-caused to extractor/shape mismatch (nested message.usage short keys vs top-level snake candidates); forensic event proves 13,852 tokens flowed while snapshot stayed empty. Split to P1 ready bug unitAI-crjh7.
